description: After Claude writes or edits a PLC file, run the structural validator. Errors are fed back to Claude; non-PLC files are ignored. Set PLC_VALIDATE_HOOK=0 to disable.

hooks.command: P="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && exec "$P" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/plc_validate.py" --hook || exit 0
